c: Write commands do not exist for test or production.
say: For test and production, write commands are not registered at all, and the credential must hold the read-only role, checked before every connection.

c: A push needs a plan, a pass, a confirmation.
say: A push needs a plan id, passing validation or a reviewed waiver, your confirmation, and records unchanged on the instance. An edit someone made there is never overwritten silently.

c: The SDK reads through snagentic's own connection.
say: The ServiceNow S D K runs inside snagentic and reads the instance through snagentic's own connection, limited to reads. It never holds a credential.
sub: The ServiceNow SDK runs inside snagentic and reads the instance through snagentic's own connection, limited to reads. It never holds a credential.

say: Instance load is a requirement. Listings use keyset paging, name their fields, and go through a scheduler with a rate limit, so an incremental pull with no changes costs about 22 requests.

c: Passwords live in the OS keychain, bound to the URL.
say: Credentials live only in the operating system keychain or environment variables, each bound to the instance it was stored for, so editing a file can't redirect it.

c: Hooks, permissions, pre-commit and the push gate enforce.
say: Skills and instructions guide the agent. Hooks, permission rules, the git pre-commit hook and the push gate enforce, in code.
